name: warehouse-marketplace-backend
description: Production Node.js, Express & Mongoose Backend for Warehouse Booking Marketplace

scripts.list:users: node -e "import('./src/config/db.js').then(m => m.connectDB()).then(async () => { const { User } = await import('./src/models/User.js'); const users = await User.find({}, 'name email role phone createdAt'); console.table(users.map(u => ({ id: u._id.toString(), name: u.name, email: u.email, role: u.role, phone: u.phone || 'N/A' }))); process.exit(0); })"
